chapter_title: The Interpretation [of] the S[i]lence, the Fast, [
spiritual_reading:
The one who gathers the scattered faculties of the mind is then empowered to bring the whole person into order, so that the cravings that rise from immersion in external things are subordinated and the outward life is made an obedient instrument of what is just. In this ordering, the mind is raised and fixed in a central support of Divine radiance, because the lower powers are held up and sustained by what flows down from higher life, and the whole is carried upward toward fuller reception.

The one they name with honor is the good that directly engages evil and begins restoration. He dwells in the outermost knowledges that have been made alive by genuine truth flowing through them, and within that outermost he abides in illumination. He is called by a name that signifies this initiating good, because those who recognize him have received a share of that radiance and so perceive what is holy in him.

The one who gives illumination to the understanding is acknowledged as the distinguisher of states, and they call that illumination the clarity by which falsity is separated from truth. By this clarity the whole domain of a person’s life is arranged as it is to be through the higher heaven of the mind. The ordered truths of that higher state are extended through the whole organized system of thought and affection, and this arrangement is made firm within the interiors of the mind and within the living principles in which persons are received and held.

fills.fill: And when the gatherer has come,
fills.notes: The substrate voice is impersonal and procedural: first the function (the ‘gatherer’ as a cosmic mechanism of collection and ordering), then its operation. This matches the spiritual sense: a power that gathers scattered faculties before re-ordering the whole person.

The correspondential context requires an ordered cycle or turning that lifts and arranges: a ‘wheel’ is a standard cosmological image for the ordered revolution by which mixtures are sifted and raised. It also fits the clause ‘the gatherer in … then he shall cause…’.
Needed after ‘cause the body …’ to express the effect of the gathering power: collection and consolidation before subordination of lusts.
Spiritual sense: cravings are subordinated. The oldest-layer register prefers structural verbs (subdue, bind, restrain) over moral exhortation.

fills.fill: and he shall set the members
fills.notes: Bridges from ‘lusts of the world’ to ‘of the body in righteousness’: the body becomes an instrument arranged into order (members set in place).
The Pillar of Glory in the substrate functions as the fixed support from higher influx; spiritual sense says the mind is ‘raised and fixed in a central support’.

fills.fill: it bears up the lower powers
fills.notes: Directly follows ‘because’: the reason for the Pillar is sustentation. This matches ‘the lower powers are held up and sustained by what flows down’.

fills.fill: by the descent of the Living Breath,
fills.notes: Oldest-layer cosmology explains support by a descending vital influx. ‘Living Breath’ is a substrate-appropriate impersonal influx-term (pneuma), avoiding later devotional phrasing.
Completes ‘up to the …’ with the spiritual sense ‘carried upward toward fuller reception’. ‘Height’ keeps the impersonal cosmological register.
Spiritual sense: ‘the one they name with honor’ is the initiating good that engages evil. ‘Honoured One’ preserves that function without importing later institutional titles.
Required to connect dwelling ‘in the ship of living waters’ to the following lacuna about light/illumination: he abides within that outermost in light.

fills.fill: the light of the first beginning;
fills.notes: Spiritual sense: within the outermost knowledges made alive, he ‘abides in illumination’. ‘first beginning’ preserves the initiating-quality of this good in oldest-layer idiom.
The name must signify ‘initiating good’. Restoring a name-title as an abstract (‘Initiation’) preserves the substrate tendency to name by function rather than biography.
Sets up the causal clause: recognition leads to participation (‘they have received a share of that radiance’).
Matches the spiritual sense precisely: reception of a share of radiance is the ground for perceiving what is holy/glorious.

fills.fill: And the enlightener of the Mind,
fills.notes: The spiritual sense explicitly identifies ‘the one who gives illumination to the understanding’. Restoring ‘Mind’ keeps the impersonal cosmological-anthropological register of the oldest layer.
The function is to distinguish states (truth from falsity). ‘enlightener of discernment’ captures this as an operative power; the phrase also yields a smooth lead-in to “l it ‘day’”.

fills.fill: the separation of truth from falsehood;
fills.notes: Spiritual sense: illumination is the clarity by which falsity is separated from truth. Oldest layer prefers ontic terms (truth, falsehood) rather than moralized language.

fills.fill: and by it they order the whole
fills.notes: Needed to connect ‘day’ (clarity) to arranging the universe/domain of life as it shall be.
Correspondentially, ‘universe’ here is the organized system of thought and affection. ‘soul’s universe’ keeps the cosmic idiom while applying it to interiors.
Supplies the verbal hinge: ‘as they shall …’ → ‘as it shall be’.
Spiritual sense: ‘ordered truths of that higher state are extended’. Thus the subject of ‘are spread in the universe’ is truths.

fills.fill: inward parts and in the living forms in which they are received.
fills.notes: Spiritual sense: arrangement is made firm ‘within the interiors of the mind and within the living principles in which persons are received and held’. This restoration keeps the substrate register (inward parts, living forms) without later ecclesial language.

assessment: Most gaps can be restored at the level of function because the spiritual translation tightly constrains the sequence: gathering and subduing, sustentation by a higher support, an initiating combatant good dwelling in enlivened outermosts, and an enlightener that separates truth from falsehood and fixes ordered truths in interiors. Exact mythic technical terms (especially ¶2 #2, ¶3 #6-7) remain less constrained without the Coptic context, so those restorations are more tentative though correspondentially consistent.
